src: single source pixels on the open side of the separator, aligned with reference pixels on the framed side
path: straight line perpendicular to the separator, staying on the same row or column
dst: adjacent to the separator when the source color equals the aligned reference color; otherwise the far outer edge on the source side
trajectory: paint only the final destination cell
transform: erase original source pixels to the source-side background; keep the separator frame and reference pixels unchanged
